name: MoYu Super RS3 M 2022 3x3 Ball-Core (Magnetic Core + MagLev)
description: The MoYu Super RS3 M 2022 3x3 the latest cube in MoYu's famous entry level 3x3 series. This version features a magnetic ball core for improved stability. It also uses MagLev technology in place of springs, which relies on repelling magnets to replicate spring force. This reduces friction and completely eliminates spring noise, as there are no springs.
features: MoYu Super RS3 M 2022 3x3 Ball-Core (Magnetic Core + MagLev) (current product)
